note: Provider tokenizer golden prompts (ZS-VIEW-008). Honesty contract: no tokenizer vocabulary is linked in this repo, so every registered family in tokenzero-core reports approximate=true. Entries with unverified=false carry asserted counts and ARE checked against count_tokens_for_model: count_class 'exact' means the count is provable without a vocabulary (empty string, single byte), count_class 'approximate' means the count is the locally derived disclosed average-width estimate and is never presented as an exact provider count. Entries with unverified=true carry NO numeric count (expected_count is null) and are TODO fill-ins to derive from a linked vocabulary or provider API; no fabricated counts enter this repo as facts.
